title: Label song search for accessibility
prompt:
In lib/widgets/autocomplete_type_ahead.dart, replace these exact lines:
      child: TextField(
        controller: _controller,
        focusNode: _focusNode,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          hintText: widget.hint,
with:
      child: TextField(
        controller: _controller,
        focusNode: _focusNode,
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          label: Semantics(label: widget.hint, child: const SizedBox.shrink()),
          hintText: widget.hint,
This supplies a persistent semantic label without changing the visible hint. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'label: Semantics(label: widget.hint, child: const SizedBox.shrink()),' lib/widgets/autocomplete_type_ahead.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/autocomplete_type_ahead.dart
